records.jp: この街燈って、可愛いよね。<CR>こういう古い感じって、なんて言うんだっけ？<CR>
records.en_original: These street lamps are cute, don't you think? What do you call stuff that's styled to be old-fashioned looking?
records.en: These street lamps are cute, don't you think? What do you call stuff that's styled to be old-fashioned looking?

records.jp: えーと……モダンとか、レトロとか？
records.en_original: Umm... You mean like retro?
records.en: Umm... You mean like retro?

records.jp: あとは、ヴィンテージとか、アンティークなんて<CR>言い方もあるかな？
records.en_original: I think you could also call it vintage?
records.en: I think you could also call it vintage?

records.jp: へえ！　愛央ちゃん、詳しい！
records.en_original: Wow, you know about stuff like this, Ao?
records.en: Wow, you know about stuff like this, Ao?

records.jp: いやー、<CR>アニメで備わった知識ですよー
records.en_original: Nah, It's just something I picked up from watching anime.
records.en: Nah, It's just something I picked up from watching anime.

records.jp: でも、それってどう違うの？
records.en_original: So then what's the difference between retro and vintage?
records.en: So then what's the difference between retro and vintage?

records.jp: えっ！？　ええと……
records.en_original: Huh? Um, well...
records.en: Huh? Um, well...

records.jp: 名前は知ってるけど<CR>詳しいことは分からないかな？
records.en_original: I know the words, but not really too much about what they actually mean.
records.en: I know the words, but not really too much about what they actually mean.

records.jp: んー、お姉ちゃんなら分かるかな？
records.en_original: Hmm... I wonder if Mio knows.
records.en: Hmm... I wonder if Mio knows.

records.jp: あ、美弦さんなら知ってるかも！<CR>今度、聞いてみよっか
records.en_original: Ah, she totally seems like she would! Let's ask her sometime.
records.en: Ah, she totally seems like she would! Let's ask her sometime.

records.jp: うん、そだね！
records.en_original: Yeah!
records.en: Yeah!

records.jp: ヴィンテージとアンティークっていうのは<CR>ジーンズとか、人形の事じゃない？
records.en_original: I think vintage is stuff like jeans and dolls, right?
records.en: I think vintage is stuff like jeans and dolls, right?

records.jp: そんで、レトロとモダンっていうのは……<CR>ええと……
records.en_original: And retro would be... Uh...
records.en: And retro would be... Uh...

records.jp: 麺の入ったお好み焼き……とか？
records.en_original: ...Jeans and dolls and stuff?
records.en: ...Jeans and dolls and stuff?

records.jp: （って、それモダン焼き！　全然違うやつ！<CR>ダメだー、上手く誤魔化せてない！）
records.en_original: (Wait, I just said the same thing twice!)
records.en: (Wait, I just said the same thing twice!)

records.jp: おお、なるほどー！
records.en_original: Oh, I get it!
records.en: Oh, I get it!

records.jp: すごいなぁ、愛央ちゃん！<CR>説明も、上手！
records.en_original: Wow, Ao! You sure are great at explaining things!
records.en: Wow, Ao! You sure are great at explaining things!

records.jp: （えええ！？　陽桜莉さん信じた！？）
records.en_original: (Huh?! She bought it?!)
records.en: (Huh?! She bought it?!)

records.jp: 私も、アニメとか見たら<CR>詳しくなれるのかなあ……
records.en_original: Maybe I should watch more anime so I can get smarter too...
records.en: Maybe I should watch more anime so I can get smarter too...

records.jp: （うう……後で、ちゃんと調べて<CR>陽桜莉さんに教えてあげよう……）
records.en_original: (I'll have to look those up and tell Hiori what they really mean later...)
records.en: (I'll have to look those up and tell Hiori what they really mean later...)

records.jp: でもさ、こういう街燈の灯りっていいよね
records.en_original: Still, the light from these is really nice, huh?
records.en: Still, the light from these is really nice, huh?

records.jp: うん。やっぱり、夜道に街燈があるだけで<CR>安心感違うもん
records.en_original: Yeah. I always feel safer when things are well-lit at night.
records.en: Yeah. I always feel safer when things are well-lit at night.

records.jp: 真っ暗なところって、怖いしね
records.en_original: The dark can be pretty scary.
records.en: The dark can be pretty scary.

records.jp: ……そういえば、愛央ちゃんって。<CR>寝る時、電気って消す？
records.en_original: Speaking of, do you turn out the lights when you sleep?
records.en: Speaking of, do you turn out the lights when you sleep?

records.jp: 消すよ。<CR>やっぱ、明るいと寝られないしね
records.en_original: Yep. I can't sleep when they're on.
records.en: Yep. I can't sleep when they're on.

records.jp: でも、明るくないと寝られない人も<CR>いるみたいだね
records.en_original: I have heard there are people who can't sleep without them, though.
records.en: I have heard there are people who can't sleep without them, though.

records.jp: うんうん。テレビつけたままじゃないと<CR>寝られないとかね
records.en_original: I even heard about someone once that can't fall asleep unless the TV is on.
records.en: I even heard about someone once that can't fall asleep unless the TV is on.

records.jp: あー、それはちょっとわかるかな。<CR>私もラジオ聞きながら、寝落ちたりするし
records.en_original: I can understand that. I sometimes fall asleep listening to the radio.
records.en: I can understand that. I sometimes fall asleep listening to the radio.

records.jp: んー、消さないかな。<CR>真っ暗だと、逆に寝付けないっていうかさ
records.en_original: Hmm... I leave them on. It's hard for me to sleep when it's completely dark.
records.en: Hmm... I leave them on. It's hard for me to sleep when it's completely dark.

records.jp: スマホの灯りとか見てると、眠くなる感じ？
records.en_original: I usually find myself dozing off while looking at my phone.
records.en: I usually find myself dozing off while looking at my phone.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃん、寝ながらスマホ弄ってるの？<CR>目、悪くなっちゃうよ
records.en_original: You fall asleep while using your phone? You'll mess up your eyes...
records.en: You fall asleep while using your phone? You'll mess up your eyes...

records.jp: そういう陽桜莉さんは、寝る前にスマホ見ないの？
records.en_original: You don't use your phone before you go to sleep then?
records.en: You don't use your phone before you go to sleep then?

records.jp: えへへ……見ちゃう
records.en_original: Teehee... I do.
records.en: Teehee... I do.

records.jp: 一緒じゃん！！
records.en_original: You hypocrite!
records.en: You hypocrite!

records.jp: 私、普段は部屋の電気消してるんだけど……
records.en_original: I usually turn off the light in my room.
records.en: I usually turn off the light in my room.

records.jp: ちょっと寂しい夜なんかは、<CR>つけたまま寝るんだよね
records.en_original: But sometimes—when I feel lonely—I'll sleep with the light on.
records.en: But sometimes—when I feel lonely—I'll sleep with the light on.

records.jp: そうなの？
records.en_original: You do?
records.en: You do?

records.jp: うん。<CR>電気ついてるとさ、なんか安心するんだ
records.en_original: Yeah. Something about having it on makes me feel better.
records.en: Yeah. Something about having it on makes me feel better.

records.jp: ……電球が付いていれば、お母さんは<CR>電球を買いに行く必要がなかったから……
records.en_original: Like, maybe if Mom knew that all the light bulbs worked, she wouldn't have needed to go buy new ones...
records.en: Like, maybe if Mom knew that all the light bulbs worked, she wouldn't have needed to go buy new ones...

records.jp: （そうだ……陽桜莉さんのお母さんは<CR>買い物に出たまま、戻らなかったんだよね）
records.en_original: (That's right... Hiori's mom went out shopping, but never came back...)
records.en: (That's right... Hiori's mom went out shopping, but never came back...)

records.jp: 明かりを絶やしたら、誰かがいなくなるような気がして<CR>ちょっと不安になっちゃうの
records.en_original: I always get scared that someone will go away whenever a light goes out.
records.en: I always get scared that someone will go away whenever a light goes out.

records.jp: なーんて……えへへ！<CR>暗いと寝れないなんて、子供っぽいかな？
records.en_original: J-Just kidding! Hehe! I bet you thought I sounded like a little kid.
records.en: J-Just kidding! Hehe! I bet you thought I sounded like a little kid.

records.jp: そんなことないよ。怖いとか、不安とか……<CR>そういうのに年齢って関係ある？
records.en_original: I don't think so. Getting older doesn't mean that you suddenly stop getting scared of that stuff.
records.en: I don't think so. Getting older doesn't mean that you suddenly stop getting scared of that stuff.

records.jp: きっと他の人達も<CR>みんなそれぞれの寝方があると思うし
records.en_original: There are plenty of people like you. Everyone's sleeping habits are different.
records.en: There are plenty of people like you. Everyone's sleeping habits are different.

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんは、陽桜莉さんのしたいように<CR>するのが一番だと思う
records.en_original: I think that you should do what's best for you, Hiori.
records.en: I think that you should do what's best for you, Hiori.

records.jp: そっか……そうだよね！
records.en_original: Yeah... I think so too!
records.en: Yeah... I think so too!

records.jp: てか、寝不足が一番困る。<CR>陽桜莉さんにも、しっかり戦ってもらわないと
records.en_original: The last thing we want is for you to not get enough sleep. We need you rested so you can help us fight.
records.en: The last thing we want is for you to not get enough sleep. We need you rested so you can help us fight.

records.jp: うん、任せて！<CR>今日も、しっかり寝ておくよ！
records.en_original: Roger that! I'll make sure I get the best sleep anyone's ever slept!
records.en: Roger that! I'll make sure I get the best sleep anyone's ever slept!

records.jp: ひとりで寝るのが不安なら<CR>私が一緒に寝てあげよっか？
records.en_original: If you ever feel scared sleeping alone, I wouldn't mind sleeping with you!
records.en: If you ever feel scared sleeping alone, I wouldn't mind sleeping with you!

records.jp: えっ、愛央ちゃんが！？
records.en_original: Huh?!
records.en: Huh?!

records.jp: うん、だったら安心かなーって
records.en_original: I thought it might help you feel better!
records.en: I thought it might help you feel better!

records.jp: ええと、でも……
records.en_original: Oh, umm...
records.en: Oh, umm...

records.jp: 私、寝相も良いし、いびきもかかないよ！<CR>……たぶん！
records.en_original: I don't snore or thrash around in my sleep at all! ...I think.
records.en: I don't snore or thrash around in my sleep at all! ...I think.

records.jp: たぶんなんだ？
records.en_original: What do you mean, you think?
records.en: What do you mean, you think?

records.jp: うん、だって自分のいびきって<CR>わかんなくない？
records.en_original: Well, you can't know if you snore yourself, right?
records.en: Well, you can't know if you snore yourself, right?

records.jp: たしかに……私も大丈夫かな？
records.en_original: That's true... I wonder if I snore?
records.en: That's true... I wonder if I snore?

records.jp: 陽桜莉さんの、いびきは<CR>きっと可愛いから、大丈夫だよ
records.en_original: Don't worry, I bet your snores are super cute if you do.
records.en: Don't worry, I bet your snores are super cute if you do.

records.jp: 愛央ちゃんのいびきだって、可愛いよ
records.en_original: Your snores would be cute, too!
records.en: Your snores would be cute, too!

records.jp: んじゃ、実際に寝て確かめてみる？
records.en_original: I guess we'll have to bunk together to find out.
records.en: I guess we'll have to bunk together to find out.

records.jp: ふふっ、そうだね！
records.en_original: Hehe! Sounds like a plan!
records.en: Hehe! Sounds like a plan!

records.jp: じゃあ、今度。<CR>寂しくなったら、愛央ちゃんを呼ぶね
records.en_original: Next time I feel lonely, I'll be sure to let you know.
records.en: Next time I feel lonely, I'll be sure to let you know.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
